The paragraph of EO 10352 amends section 6.10-1 to read as the order sets out, and sets out the text of 6.10-1; that same text, with source line E.O. 10352, is the current held eCFR text of 33 CFR 6.10-1. The four later orders that amend Part 6 each name other sections (see the listed events) and none revokes or rewrites 6.10-1, so the command was not ended.

research_rationale:
EO 10352 (signed 1952-05-19; 17 FR 4607, filed 1952-05-20, printed in the Federal Register of 1952-05-21) has one operative paragraph: it amends section 6.10-1 of 33 CFR Part 6 (the regulations prescribed by EO 10173 as amended by EO 10277) to read as the order sets out. The held text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_10352.txt was read in full and its identity (number, title, date, signer, FR page) matches the register row. The order states no effective date other than its signing, no own-terms end and no savings clause. I searched the held texts for the order's number: later orders EO 11249 (1965-10-10), EO 13143 (1999-12-01), EO 13273 (2002-08-21) and EO 14116 (2024-02-21) amend other sections of 33 CFR Part 6 (11249: 6.01-3, 6.01-4, new 6.01-5, 6.04-5, new 6.04-6, 6.04-7; 13143: 6.01-4; 13273: new 6.01-6 and 6.04-1; 14116: 6.01-3, 6.01-5, new sections after 6.01-6 and 6.01-7, 6.04-5 through 6.04-8, 6.10-7, 6.14-1 and later sections) and none amends, supersedes or revokes section 6.10-1 or EO 10352. The Federal Register disposition note for EO 10352 reads 'See: EO 11249, October 10, 1965' and EO 11249 recites EO 10352 only in its preamble. The current-law machine searches (U.S. Code release point 119-121 current through 2026-10-09, so laws enacted from 2026-10-10 to 2026-10-14 are not reflected; eCFR as of 2026-10-14) were read for coverage; the eCFR hits are 33 CFR 6.10-1, 33 CFR part 125 and 29 CFR 1915.2, and the held eCFR text of 33 CFR 6.10-1 (jobs/theophilus-sources/output/texts/cfr-t33-6.10-1.txt) still carries the same sentence as the order, with the source line '[E.O. 10352, 17 FR 4624, May 21, 1952]' (that citation is the Coast Guard implementing page, the order itself is at 17 FR 4607). No revocation of EO 10352, EO 10173 or Part 6 appears in the held sources.
